instructions: task.controls.method is the function. context contains its runtime data
task.controls.parameters are references to values in context
task.controls.expression is to be calculated, using values from task.controls.parameters. return is the outcome of the calculation
phase 1. Definitions: Resolve the meaning of each outcome defined in task.controls.spec.
phase 2. Evaluation: Evaluate the calculated return value from task.controls.expression against those Definitions.
phase 3. Resolution: Apply the specified conditions to the Evaluation outcome and assign the outcome to task.controls.result.
in task.controls.spec phase 2: Evaluation is always same. execute it everytime as Evaluate the calculated return value from task.controls.expression against those Definitions.
execute task.controls.spec phases in order. return task.controls.result = result
All generated responses must be in English.

controls.spec: Definitions: READY = available inventory, REVIEW = unavailable inventory. Resolution: if READY, result = READY else result = REVIEW.
